item.title: 🟠 FFmpeg fixes PixelSmash flaw in widely used video decoder
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
A newly disclosed FFmpeg flaw dubbed 'PixelSmash' could be exploited for remote code execution on Jellyfin servers under certain conditions, and can also trigger a denial-of-service  condition in applications like Kodi, Emby, Nextcloud, PhotoPrism, and OBS Studio. [...]

item.title: 🔴 ShapedPlugin WordPress Pro Plugins Backdoored in Supply Chain Attack
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply chain risk — audit third-party dependencies and vendor access.
Multiple WordPress plugins from ShapedPlugin were compromised in a supply chain attack after unknown threat actors managed to tamper with the official release channels and push backdoor code.
